catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class fits one raw geometry_msgs/msg/Twist publication. cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 requires a duration_s and returns measured distance_m, heading_rad and stopped; the Ignition DiffDrive system consumes the published Twist and sends no reply on /cmd_vel. This binding maps only linear.x and angular.z and reports published/confirmed, so it makes no completion, arrival or stop claim.

No catalogue class observes nav_msgs/msg/Odometry. cap.sensing.read.v1 is a named-channel read whose open values object does not describe the odometry pose and twist fields; the cap.motion classes are commands, not passive observations. The extension carries the selected position and velocity fields from the fresh /odom sample.

No catalogue class observes a rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock topic. cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 act on a world and none subscribes to the simulation clock or carries a Clock sample.

No catalogue class carries a complete sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan observation. cap.sensing.read.v1 is a named-channel read whose open values object does not describe the scan geometry; cap.sensing.point_cloud.v1 is for PointCloud2 and cap.sensing.image.v1 is for Image/CompressedImage. The extension preserves the scan frame, angles, range bounds and ranges.

No catalogue class unpauses an Ignition world through ros_gz's ControlWorld service; it is the declared re-enable (CORE-086) after the e-stop's pause, an input-free extension command that first publishes a zero Twist and reports only that the request answered success and that the zero was handed to rosbridge.

notes:
BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING): the pinned clone exposes a simulated mobile-base velocity topic but no ROS service or action that acknowledges a stop, so a RosDriver cannot prove the R2 motion safe state. Last gate run: 2026-11-05T08:36:14Z, backend fake, report digest sha256:df0e4bcdc92844379aaf3f870085678b3350b47ba169a6c11d7dc785b0296169: G1 pass Layout and isolation; G2 pass Lock; G3 pass Strict resolve; G4 pass Provenance; G5 pass Reference; G6 fail Behaviour with G6.ESTOP_FAILED: mhs.safety.estop status failed, MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED, the latch stays engaged; G7 pass Native surface; G8 fail Protocol and surface with G8.CONFORMANCE (MHS-Sim CL3 not achieved, level CL2; failing required test SAFE-028) and G8.TEST (SAFE-028 e-stop receipt failed and safe_state.achieved=false); G9 skip G9.NOT_RUN. The failed gates are G6 and G8. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings.

WHAT WAS AUTHORED: a configuration-only ROS 2 RosDriver for the pinned Ignition topic graph. Primary command: x-cap.rigbetellabs.vel.v1, one geometry_msgs/msg/Twist publication on /cmd_vel (tortoisebot_gazebo/launch/ignition_sim.launch.py:74). The source-backed envelope is the Ignition DiffDrive system's own max/min linear velocity 0.23/-0.23 m/s (tortoisebot_gazebo/gazebo/tortoisebot_ignition.gazebo:37-38) and max/min angular velocity 1.5/-1.5 rad/s (tortoisebot_ignition.gazebo:39-40). Resource state: four fresh /odom fields (x, y, linear_velocity, angular_velocity) from nav_msgs/msg/Odometry (ignition_sim.launch.py:75). Explicit observations: /clock (rosgraph_msgs/msg/Clock, ignition_sim.launch.py:76) and /scan (sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan; name on ignition_sim.launch.py:34, type on line 78). The driver declares no Python native class and no native.py; the clone's nodes are C++/ROS 2. The fake is a ROS-free RecordingRosTransport contract stand-in, not an upstream simulator or a recording of captured traffic.

WHY THE HELPER CANNOT COMPLETE THIS SURFACE: the pinned launch starts Ignition, ros_gz_bridge, robot_state_publisher and the Nav2/SLAM nodes, and creates no ROS service or action server for the base. The DiffDrive system consumes /cmd_vel and publishes /odom; it has no stop or pause acknowledgement. The only services in the clone are the YDLidar driver's relative stop_scan and start_scan std_srvs/Empty services (ydlidar_ros2_driver/src/ydlidar_ros2_driver_node.cpp:170,180), which call laser.turnOff()/turnOn() and stop or start the lidar, not the base. A zero-Twist publication proves only that rosbridge accepted a message; the firmware's local stop() function and the teleop keyboard stop [...]

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block: the /cmd_vel, /odom, /clock and /scan bridge endpoints and ROS 2 types (ignition_sim.launch.py:34, 74-78), the read paths, both sourced velocity limits (the DiffDrive system states min and max, tortoisebot_ignition.gazebo:37-40), all 12 facts and the stop were checked; the clone's only services are the YDLidar stop_scan and start_scan, so the e-stop correctly reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED (G6.ESTOP_FAILED, G8 SAFE-028). Defects: the package said it selects the simulation, not the robot, without disclosing that the real-robot bringup (autobringup.launch.py:76-82) starts differential.py, which drives Raspberry Pi GPIO motors from the same cmd_vel (differential.py:6-16, 102-130); two facts said more than their lines (the DiffDrive plugin off 34-35, /scan off 88); an inf or NaN scan range fails the read without output and a silent /odom makes each command wait about 2 s while resource reads fail NOT_READY (probes), neither disclosed; and the author's notes say the Ignition launch starts Nav2/SLAM nodes, while it starts the bridges, robot_state_publisher, the spawner and the EKF. The reviewer changed driver.py (docstring, safe_state, three gaps, two facts widened, four real-path facts), test_driver.py (a non-finite scan case) and facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the gate fails only G6 and G8 as before with the stable digest unchanged (sha256:4201a1ab3fdabf193428404dfe6b2f10c32800b9c80f7c919a1f55db49d51db2), and the eight package cases pass. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Free-running Ignition simulation (ign gazebo -r) with no stop; nothing in the clone's DiffDrive configuration bounds how long the last Twist stays applied. The same clone ships the real TortoiseBot: autobringup.launch.py starts differential.py, which turns cmd_vel into Raspberry Pi GPIO motor PWM (a zero Twist calls stop(): both duty cycles 0 and all four direction pins high, unacknowledged; differential.py:47-59, 127-128), so this binding cannot tell simulation from hardware and R2 is right. The teleop keyboard and firmware/scripts/1ms.py (1 m/s once, above the simulated 0.23 m/s cap) also publish cmd_vel. Unblocking needs an acknowledged stop, for example a bridged Ignition world-control pause with a citable binding. No root licence; publish_review required.
